# Skill

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [D20 Tests](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Skill)*

A skill is an area of specialization associated with an ability check. If you have [proficiency](Proficiency.md) in a skill, you can add your Proficiency Bonus when you make an ability check associated with that skill. *See also* "Playing the Game" ("[Proficiency](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/playing-the-game#SkillProficiencies)").
